europe_now.title: EU faces winter gas-price spiral as stocks run low
europe_now.summary: European gas reserves have fallen to critically low levels heading into winter, raising concerns about price volatility and supply security across the continent. The situation reflects broader energy market tensions affecting EU member states.

sources.headline: EU risks winter gas-price spiral, as stocks run low

top_stories.title: Ukraine civilian casualties reach highest level since 2022
top_stories.summary: Ukraine has recorded its highest monthly civilian casualty count since 2022, reflecting intensified hostilities across frontline regions. The spike highlights the continued human cost of the conflict in affected areas.

sources.headline: Ukraine's monthly civilian casualties highest since 2022

top_stories.title: EU packaging regime restricts small publishers in single market
top_stories.summary: The EU's new packaging regime restricts small publishers from operating freely in the single market. The measure impacts independent publishing houses across member states.

sources.headline: EU new packaging regime locks small publishers out of single market
